business: Moduo Duo: an all-in-one workspace with chat for two people working together
target: Two-person teams (co-founders, partner pairs, a freelancer plus an assistant) who coordinate across Slack or WhatsApp, Notion and a shared task app
where: Online; mostly US, UK and EU

segments.name: Partners in a small service business
Solo operator with an assistant or VA

behaviours.name: Slack plus Notion pair
behaviours.how: Chats in Slack's free plan and keeps docs and tasks in a shared Notion.

behaviours.name: WhatsApp coordinators
behaviours.how: Run the business through a WhatsApp chat and a shared Google Sheet.

behaviours.name: One partner decides tools
behaviours.how: One of the two picks the tools; the other goes along if it's easy.

behaviours.name: Subscription trimmer
behaviours.how: Cuts anything that costs per seat and isn't used daily by both.

behaviours.name: Couple running a business
behaviours.how: Mixes household and business admin in the same tools.

behaviours.name: Early adopter
behaviours.how: Likes trying new tools together and moves fast.

behaviours.name: Google Workspace pair
behaviours.how: Share Gmail, Google Docs and Google Chat through a Workspace plan they already pay for.

objections: Slack's free plan already covers our chat
Getting my partner to switch apps is the hard part
We'd lose our Notion setup and templates
What happens when we hire a third person?
A small startup's chat won't be as reliable as Slack or WhatsApp
$20 a month is more than we pay now
We need it on our phones
habits: you and your partner have a standing Monday call to sync on who's doing what
you lost track of who replied to a client last week
half your coordination happens in voice notes
you share one Google Calendar for the business
_notes: Draws on PRODUCT_BRIEF.md section 2 (partner/founder pairs, primary close second) and the 2026-10-02 chat decision. No mobile app is a real gap for this group. Shares and incomes are guesses. Founders' review 2026-10-19: early adopters cut to 5%, added a Google Workspace pair at 10%.
